label: early original-phase b (and k/j/h) input after a b/z/g/w/m/n/0 context
explanation: Fires almost only in the original (input) phase, on positions 0-3 (99.9% of mass; nearly nothing at t>=4, the delimiter, or the copy phase). The main trigger is the input token b (57% of mass, 18x lift). At t=0, b always fires weakly (about 0.09 of max). At t=1-3, b fires strongly when the previous token is b, z, g, w, m, n or 0, and the strongest activations are repeated b runs (b b b, z b b). Secondary triggers are k, j and h (and more weakly v, i, 2) at t=1-3, gated by a similar preceding-token context. Magnitude goes up with position (t=1-2 carry most of the mass) and with a preceding b. It does not fire on b after other tokens such as q, 3, a, o, f or r, and it does not fire on most other letters. The context gating is a lookup-like set of tokens, so precision and recall stay incomplete (dev F1 0.67, mass recall 0.75).

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by step (t=0: b; t=1: b, k, j, h; t=2: b, k, j, h) and the previous input (most: b, g, w, z, n, 0; least: o, x, c, f); timing cues that raise it most: t=2, t=3, L=3 & t=4.
